mentions.name: Diwan-i-Am
mentions.passage:
The original court of the Diwan-i-Am, some 560 feet long by 300 feet in
width, was entered, as has been stated above, through the Naubat Khana,
and was formerly surrounded by arcaded apartments used by chiefs and
Umaras on duty.

mentions.name: gateway
mentions.passage:
To the north of the great hall was a gateway leading
to another smaller court, the “ ante-court,” if one may use the term, to
the larger of the two courtyards before the Ihwan-i-Khas.
